pronunciation: ngah-chuh (the 'ng' as in 'singer'; the final 'ṳ' is a flat, unrounded vowel like the 'i' in 'sir' without the r)

example.english: You must brush your teeth every day.

note: In Hakka the word begins with the nasal 'ng-', a sound Mandarin lacks, so learners often drop it. To say 'toothache' you can say 牙齒痛 (ngà-chṳ́ thung).
